PRJNA681237

LOADING PACKAGES

library("DESeq2")
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(apeglm)
library(ggplot2)
library("EnhancedVolcano")
library("tidyr")
library(edgeR)
library(patchwork)
library(Biostrings)
library("seqinr")
library(vegan)
library(ape)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)

LOADING FILES

# load metadata
SRRs <- read.csv("metadata.csv", header = TRUE)
SRRs <- SRRs %>%
  mutate(time = case_when(
    treatment_time == "untreated" ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(str_remove_all(treatment_time, " min with phage")))) %>%
  arrange(time)

SRRs <- SRRs %>%
  group_by(medium, time) %>%
  mutate(rep = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(condition = paste0(time, "_", medium, "_", rep))

# load gene counts for each run
cts <- read.table("../counts_batch1.tsv", header = TRUE)
names(cts)[names(cts) == "run_accession"] <- "Run"

# select runs from PRJNA681237
cts <- cts %>%
  filter(Run %in% SRRs$Run) %>%
  mutate(Gene_origin = ifelse(
    grepl("^NZ", Chr),
    "Bacteria",
    "Phage"
  ))

cts$Geneid <- sub("^cds-", "", cts$Geneid)
cts$Geneid <- sub("^rna-", "", cts$Geneid)

# load defense systems of the bacteria obtained from defense finder
ds <- read.csv("defense_systems.csv", header = TRUE)[, c("Geneid", "protein_in_syst", "type")]

EDA

# Number of bacterial and phage gene counts per run
cts_per_run_b_p <- cts %>%
  left_join(SRRs, by = "Run") # join with SRR to get the condition to label

cts_per_run_b_p <- cts_per_run_b_p %>%
  group_by(condition, Gene_origin) %>%
  summarise(counts = sum(counts), .groups = "drop") %>%
  as.data.frame()
colnames(cts_per_run_b_p)[colnames(cts_per_run_b_p) == "Library.Name"] <- "Run"
# Plots bacteria and phage gene counts per run 
ggplot(cts_per_run_b_p, aes(x = condition, y = counts)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Run",
    y = "# reads",
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90) 
)

# Construction of a distance matrix for PCoA
dist_matrix_cts <- cts[c("Run", "Geneid", 'counts')] %>%
  group_by(Run, Geneid) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Run,
    values_from = counts, 
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(dist_matrix_cts) <- dist_matrix_cts$Geneid
dist_matrix_cts <- dist_matrix_cts[ , -1]

dist_matrix_cts <- vegdist(t(dist_matrix_cts), method = "euclidean")

# Compute principal coordinate decomposition
pcoa <- pcoa(dist_matrix_cts)

# Plot PCoA2 vs PCoA2
pcoa_df <- data.frame(
  Run = rownames(pcoa$vectors),
  Axis1 = pcoa$vectors[, 1],
  Axis2 = pcoa$vectors[, 2]
)
pcoa_df <- left_join(pcoa_df, SRRs, by = "Run")

ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, color = time, label = time)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.8, size = 3.5, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PCoA 1 (", round(pcoa$values$Relative_eig[1] * 100, 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA 2 (", round(pcoa$values$Relative_eig[2] * 100, 1), "%)"),
    color = "Time post infection")

COUNT MATRIX

cnt_matrix <- cts %>% 
# filter bacteria genes   
  left_join(SRRs, by = "Run") %>%   
  select(Geneid, condition, counts) %>%   
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition,               
              values_from = counts,               
              values_fill = 0) %>%   
  as.data.frame()  
rownames(cnt_matrix) <- cnt_matrix$Geneid 
cnt_matrix <- cnt_matrix[ , -1] 
cnt_matrix <- cnt_matrix[, order(names(cnt_matrix))]

CLR

# Add pseudocount to avoid counts = 0
pseudocount <- min(cnt_matrix[cnt_matrix > 0])/10 
# Transform the cts_matrix dataframe into a Deseq object
dds_for_vst <- cnt_matrix + pseudocount

dds_for_vst <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(round(dds_for_vst), as.data.frame(colnames(dds_for_vst)), design = ~ 1)
# Apply a variance stabilizing transformation (VST) to the count data
vst <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds_for_vst) %>%
  assay() %>%
  as.data.frame()

vst <- 2^(vst)

# Normalization by gene length
genes_length <- cts[match(intersect(rownames(vst), cts$Geneid), cts$Geneid), ]$Length
vst <- vst/(genes_length * 10^(-3))

# Centered Log2 Ratio (CLR)
clr <- log2(vst / exp(rowMeans(log(vst))))
plot_CLR <- function(protein, ds_type) {
  protein_clr <- clr[protein, ]

  protein_clr <- protein_clr %>%
    t() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rename(value = protein) %>%
    rownames_to_column("time_medium_rep") %>%
    separate(time_medium_rep, into = c("time", "medium", "rep"), sep = "_") %>%
    mutate(time = as.numeric(time))

  # compute mean and se
  median_clr <- protein_clr %>%
    group_by(medium, time) %>%
    summarise(
      median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), 
      .groups = "keep"
    )

  # Plot
  ggplot(median_clr, aes(x = time, y = median, color = medium, group = medium)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = median-sd, ymax = median+sd)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_manual(
    values = c("LB" = "red",  
               "MCCM" = "darkblue")   
    ) +
    ylim(-2.5, 2.5) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Defense system = ", ds_type),
      x = "Time post infection (min)",
      y = "CLR"
    )
}
plots <- list()

for (i in rownames(ds)) {
  plots[[i]] <- plot_CLR(ds[i, ]$protein_in_syst, ds[i, ]$type)
}

wrap_plots(plots[1:5], ncol = 3)

DESEQ + VOLCANO PLOT FUNCTION (control vs infected)

deseq_volcano_c_i <- function(t, medium) {
  # columns of cnt_matrix to select
  cols <- c(
      paste0("0_", medium, "_1"),
      paste0("0_", medium, "_2"),
      paste0("0_", medium, "_3"),
      paste0(t, "_", medium, "_1"),
      paste0(t, "_", medium, "_2"),
      paste0(t, "_", medium, "_3")
    )
  
  # construction of DESeq dataset
  coldata <- data.frame(
    row.names = cols,
    condition = factor(c("control", "control", "control", "infected", "infected", "infected"))
  )
  
  countData <- round(cnt_matrix[,cols])
  
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = countData,
                                colData = coldata,
                                design = ~ condition)
  
  # differential expression analysis
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  res <- as.data.frame(results(dds, alpha = 0.1, pAdjustMethod = "fdr"))
  
  # label for defense genes 
  labels <- ds$type[match(rownames(res), ds$protein_in_syst)]
  labels[is.na(labels)] <- ""
  
  # add column labels (character and logical)
  res <- mutate(res, label=labels)
  res <- mutate(res, ds = factor(res$label != ""))
  
  # plot -Log10 FDR vs Log fold change
  plot <- ggplot(res, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = ds)) +
    geom_point(data = subset(res, ds == "FALSE"), color = "grey", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = subset(res, ds == "TRUE"), color = "darkgreen") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_label_repel(data = subset(res, ds == "TRUE" & padj < 0.05),
        aes(label = label), 
        size = 3, 
        max.overlaps = Inf, 
        show.legend = NA,
        colour = "black"
  ) +
    xlim(-5, 5) +
    ylim(0, 15) +
    annotate("text", x=0, y=13, label = paste0(t, " min (C vs I) - ", medium)) +
    theme_bw()


  return(plot)
}
